snippet.title: Jaden Industries: Cozy Automation Puzzler | Announcement Trailer | Gamflix
snippet.description:
Jaden Industries is a relaxing factory-building puzzle game about managing compact crafting chains across floating islands. As an expedition engineer, you’ll explore a peaceful Archipelago, configure production flows, refine resources, and achieve perfect efficiency.


Minimum:
OS: Windows 10
